description: This source file defines the ApiCallAttemptMonitoringMiddleware class, which extends AbstractMonitoringMiddleware. It provides methods for wrapping middleware handlers, extracting request and response data, and handling different types of results and exceptions related to AWS SDK client monitoring. The class is used internally within the AWS SDK for PHP to monitor API call attempts and collect metrics.

classes.name: ApiCallAttemptMonitoringMiddleware
classes.description: Internal class used in AWS SDK PHP for monitoring API call attempts, extracting relevant data from requests, responses, and exceptions, and providing middleware wrapping functionality.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware handler with given credentials provider, options, region, and service parameters.

methods.name: getRequestData
methods.description: Extracts request data such as the host from the given HTTP request.

methods.name: getResponseData
methods.description: Extracts various response or exception metrics (latency, IP, HTTP status, headers) depending on the result type.

methods.name: populateRequestEventData
methods.description: Populates event data with request-specific details, setting event type to 'ApiCallAttempt'.

methods.name: populateResultEventData
methods.description: Populates event data with result-specific details, including credentials info and latency.

methods.name: getResultAttemptLatency
methods.description: Retrieves the attempt latency in milliseconds from a ResultInterface object.

methods.name: getResultDestinationIp
methods.description: Retrieves the primary IP address from the ResultInterface transfer stats.

methods.name: getResultDnsLatency
methods.description: Retrieves DNS lookup latency in milliseconds from the ResultInterface transfer stats.

methods.name: getResultHttpStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code from the ResultInterface metadata.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionAttemptLatency
methods.description: Retrieves the attempt latency in milliseconds from an AwsException's transfer info.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the AWS error code from an AwsException.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionMessage
methods.description: Returns the AWS error message from an AwsException.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionDestinationIp
methods.description: Retrieves the primary IP address from an AwsException's transfer info.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionDnsLatency
methods.description: Retrieves DNS lookup latency in milliseconds from an AwsException's transfer info.

methods.name: getAwsExceptionHttpStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code from an AwsException's response.

methods.name: getExceptionHttpStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code from a generic Exception if it contains a ResponseInterface.

methods.name: getExceptionCode
methods.description: Returns the exception class name unless it's an AwsException, in which case null.

methods.name: getExceptionMessage
methods.description: Returns the exception message unless it's an AwsException, in which case null.
